parsed_response.rationale:
The current low-level goals (LLGs) are complete, supported, and non-redundant. They accurately represent the parent high-level goal of providing citizens with dual-view access to public reports through an interactive map and summary table, both supporting dynamic filtering and sorting by category, status, or date. The LLGs cover the essential capabilities of displaying reports based on citizen-selected location (llg_001), presenting a summary table with metadata (llg_002), applying filters to reports (llg_003), and sorting reports (llg_004). No unsupported or misleading LLGs are identified, nor are there any missing essential capabilities. The decomposition is well-structured and aligns with the source evidence provided in the project description.
